details.constructor: kgsl_drawobj_cmd_create returns ERR_PTR on allocation/init error;drawobj_init takes context get-unless-zero before kref_init and stores context. On success command type increments proc cmd_count/period active_cmds,with separate work-period ref behavior. Caller already holds its own context owner ref;done puts that caller ref. Object-held context ref reaches kgsl_context_put only via final drawobj destroy_object callback,whose cmd callback kfrees object. Exact selected core kref implementation is not bound and no refcount methods executed.
details.node_storage: kgsl_drawobj_add_memobject allocates list-node metadata and copies supplied gpuaddr/size/id/offset/flags;it does not itself take a kgsl_mem_entry reference. _verify_ib only checks supplied range/alignment/size. This does not attest real live backing,domain/route/VA identity or GPU access. Only optional profiling path takes a mem-entry ref through actual lookup;do not mistake node copies for memory ownership.
details.ioctl_two_objects: Recurring ioctl constructs one new cmdobj even for STOP,clears PROFILING before cmdlist/memlist construction. START queue verifies and sets START under device mutex;successful callback assigns this same cmdobj to recurring_cmdobj without independent kref_get. Source API0 leads caller to keep it;regular nonzero except -EPROTO leads caller destroy. STOP dequeue ignores newly constructed ioctl cmdobj and sends existing tracked cmdobj from matching context under device mutex;on successful STOP callback retires tracked one,then ioctl destroys its separate temporary object. Error destroys temporary object under the original non-EPROTO rule,tracked one remains. These are source ownership conventions,not hardware success peers.
details.EPROTO_boundary: The copied ioctl -EPROTO exception is preserved. It is not a generic accepted/retired guarantee. This phase does not claim a concrete recurring -EPROTO return producer is reachable for exact selected configuration;no speculative leak/error cleanup patch is added. Null/ERR create path is handled by existing IS_ERR_OR_NULL destroy guard.
details.callback_error: Existing callback returns errors before recurring_cmdobj assignment,including after command send/ACK wait. An error after publication does not prove hardware has relinquished supplied buffers;ioctl error destruction and cleanup are not adopted as a native stop/DMA policy. Existing tracked object stays on unsuccessful STOP/replay;new23rd count patch is independent,does not add object references.
details.retirement: adreno_hwsched_retire_cmdobj updates perf/frame bookkeeping,may return early if nonnull profiling entry cannot translate,then drops extra big_cmdobj ref if equal and calls destroy. Destroy invokes cmdobj cleanup BEFORE put:it deletes/frees metadata list nodes and decrements cmd counters,then put ultimately drops context/free after final reference callback. Extra reference alone does not retain already-cleared command-list contents. No arbitrary double destroy safety,full destruction completion,IRQ quiescence or DMA retirement is inferred.
details.profiling_reachability: Recurring ioctl clears PROFILING before add_memlist;add_profiling_buffer returns immediately unless that flag exists,so profiling_buf_entry remains zero on this serial exact construction path. Thus retire profiling early return is a conditional generic helper shape,not shown reachable from this recurring producer. No new guard,forced cleanup or free policy is invented.
details.replay_and_readers: Replay can change existing object START to STOP for invalid context,then calls same callback and ignores its int. Diagnostic reset/snapshot consumer conditionally takes a separate drawobj kref then puts later;this does not establish arbitrary simultaneous API lifetime or preserve command-list contents through destroy. Original owner/mutex conventions only,no core queue/kref/cancel semantics or external fence manager bound.
